group.name: Centre des Technologies de l’Etat
group.description: The Government IT Centre (Centre des Technologies de l’Etat - CTIE) is the central player in the setting up and development of eGovernment. Its main mission is to accompany the digital transition of the Grand Duchy’s administrations, so that each of them may take full advantage of the opportunities offered by the information and communication technologies (ICTs), in an intelligent, considered and organised fashion.
